## The rate

The fixed rate method allows a deduction of 70 cents for each hour worked from
home for the 2024-25 and 2025-26 income years. The rate was 67 cents per hour
for 2022-23 and 2023-24, and 52 cents per hour for 2020-21 and 2021-22.

## What the rate covers

The hourly rate covers home and mobile internet or data expenses, mobile and
home phone usage, electricity and gas for heating, cooling and lighting, and
stationery and computer consumables such as printer ink and paper. These items
cannot be claimed separately on top of the fixed rate.

## What you can claim separately

Depreciating assets such as computers, office chairs and desks are not covered
by the rate and may be claimed separately, as may repairs and maintenance of
those assets. In limited circumstances where there is a dedicated home office,
occupancy expenses and cleaning may also be claimable.

## Records you need

A record of the actual hours worked from home must be kept, such as a timesheet,
roster or diary. Estimates of hours are not accepted. At least one record must
be kept for each expense the rate covers. Records must be kept for 5 years from
the date the tax return is lodged.
